value.rationale: The newly formulated definite-set Fourier sign-uncertainty observable motivates sharp finite-mode benchmarks. The first three negative-eigenvalue Hermite orders form a natural finite spectral truncation. Exact minimization is nontrivial because the additional 10th-order mode introduces a free real parameter and possibly disconnected negative intervals; the proof identifies a rigid unique extremizer and exact algebraic sign length, not just a numerical example or a restatement of a general theorem. It is a complete natural classification of this motivated finite truncation and is explicitly not a claim about all eigenfunctions.
